answer_4.quote: We employ a double-blind 120 human study (of which 77 pass the rigorous sanity check) to compare pre-TTS (N := 1) and post-TTS (N := 4) preference scores.
answer_4.guideline: Each participant is presented with a random TTS sample and asked to indicate preference between pre- and post-feedback charts using a 5-point scale: strongly prefer pre-feedback, prefer pre-feedback, indifferent, prefer post-feedback, strongly prefer post-feedback.
